subject: Capacity realignment & band exception — infrastructure prioritization
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, BrightPath Talent <sarah@brightpathtalent.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Capacity realignment + comp-band exception request

Team —

Quick note to surface a recommended realignment of our Y3 runtime/platform open headcount following the two unexpected departures in July (one SRE, one runtime SWE). After modeling throughput risk and feature roadmaps, I propose the following temporary adjustments to preserve latency SLAs and planned infra initiatives:

- Hold the two junior platform SWE openings and reallocate 1 headcount to fill a senior Runtime Engineer (Band 5) instead.
- Convert one SRE req to a Principal Platform Reliability hire (Band 6) — this is a band exception request; the market for on-call, k-v cache and kernel-level optimization experience requires a higher band to be competitive.
- Keep one junior infra contractor slot funded through Q4 for spikes.

I've attached the runtime_hc_model_v2.xlsx with projected SLO risk curves and the comp_band_exception_form.pdf for the Band 6 ask.

Ask: Kimberly — can you review the comp-band exception + budget delta? Marcus and Jonas — can you confirm this doesn't materially affect upcoming product launches? I'm proposing we finalize by EOD Thursday (8/12) so recruiting can pivot.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: runtime_hc_model_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
Attachment: comp_band_exception_form.pdf (pdf, 78KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-09T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity realignment + comp-band exception request

Vanessa —

Thanks for the packet and the model. Initial thoughts: the Band 6 exception will increase FY26 run-rate by ~12% for the role (see sheet tab 'comp_impact'). HR needs justification with 3 datapoints: competitive comps for equivalent roles, a short list of must-have skills, and the proposed hiring timeline.

Can you add a one-page rationale (bullet list) to the comp_band_exception_form.pdf and confirm the expected start date window? Also need to know whether the budget will come from Q3 discretionary or reallocated from open hiring pools. If you can send that by EOD tomorrow we can route the exception to Finance for approval.

One more ask: please put the two roles you plan to pause into Workday as 'on hold' so we don't keep screening.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Chief People Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity realignment + comp-band exception request

+1 to Vanessa's prioritization. The runtime Band 5 hire is critical for our decoder optimizations planned in Q3 — without it we likely push one milestone. The Principal Platform Reliability (Band 6) makes sense if the person can own kernel-level perf efforts + oncall automation.

Marcus — does this shift break your capacity for the rollout?

-Jonas
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-10T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity realignment + comp-band exception request

We ran a quick resource-impact check. Short answer: we can absorb the reallocation with two conditions —

1) The runtime Band 5 hires are prioritized into the lowest-latency workstreams for the first 12 weeks.
2) The contractor slot stays active through December and we convert it to an FTE only if the Band 6 ask is approved and we still have budget.

If Kimberly confirms funding source, I'm ok greenlighting the pause on the two junior platform searches.

-Marcus
Sr. Director, Runtime Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Talent <sarah@brightpathtalent.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T07:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity realignment + comp-band exception request

Thanks — short follow-up and added detail (per Kimberly's ask):

- One-pager rationale attached to comp_band_exception_form.pdf (included in thread). Key bullets: cache/kv-store and custom kernel experience is scarce; market data shows Band 6 is necessary to attract candidates with both systems + compiler-level perf experience.
- Proposed start window: Oct 4–18 (allows recruiting and notice period).
- Budget: reallocate $180k from two paused junior reqs + $45k from discretionary Q3 training line to cover FY26 delta. Finance pre-check passed (see doc link in related_links).

Sarah (BrightPath) — can you stop outbound for the two paused junior platform roles and prioritize Sr Runtime + Principal Reliability searches? If you need job spec edits I'll loop PMs.

Vanessa

---
Attachment: comp_band_exception_form.pdf (updated, 3 pages)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath Talent <sarah@brightpathtalent.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T15:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity realignment + comp-band exception request

Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick update and rationale. Finance has provisionally approved the internal reallocation and the discretionary offset. Formal approval requires one final sign-off from the CFO but I expect no blockers. Consider this "provisionally approved" so recruiting can pivot.

Actions: Jonas/Marcus to prioritize onboarding plan for Band 5 (12-week ramp), Sarah to start targeted outreach for Band 5/6 immediately, and Vanessa to mark the two junior reqs as 'on hold' in Workday.

I'll ping Finance for CFO sign-off and confirm by Friday EOD.

-Kimberly
